method: Turbospectrum LTE flux synthesis with in-window blend handling vs the observed solar spectrum (Sirius); NLTE delta from committed Sr_Bergemann2012_INSPECT grid. gf/EP from canonical linelist_solar. Decision on SENSITIVITY + COVERAGE, never proximity to Asplund (validate-don't-tune).

arms.harps: reflected-solar HARPS normalized spectrum (primary, per RYA-421)
arms.iag: IAG Reiners+2016 disk-integrated FTS solar flux atlas (cross-check; ESPRESSO solar not staged anywhere, IAG is the honest cross-source check)

4077.709.why: resonance line, HIGHEST abundance sensitivity (203 mA/dex), NLTE-covered (delta -0.004), clean fit. Wins on sensitivity AND coverage.

4215.519.why: resonance, good sensitivity + NLTE-covered, BUT Fe I blend (Bergemann 2012a) inflates the fit residual (worst red_chi2) and grows toward cool stars -> cross-check with cool-star caution (SR2_COOLSTAR_TEFF_K).

4161.792.why: subordinate (EP 2.94); CLEANEST fit (lowest red_chi2) but LOW sensitivity (36 mA/dex) and NOT in the NLTE grid. LTE defensible at solar (resonance corr is only -0.004/-0.006; a higher-EP subordinate line is even less NLTE-sensitive). Usable LTE cross-check, flagged NLTE_unavailable (never a silent zero).

4305.443.why: subordinate (EP 3.04); the synthesis fit RAILED with ~ZERO abundance sensitivity (0.2 mA/dex) -> the line does not constrain A(Sr). NOT an abundance line. This is exactly the RYA-429 saturated_core artifact seen for what it is: a blend, not a measurement.

decision.rationale: Sensitivity-ranked: 4077 (203) > 4215 (128) > 4161 (36) >> 4305 (0.2 mA/dex). 4077 wins on sensitivity AND coverage -> PRIMARY. Per RYA-430's explicit instruction the subordinate lines are NOT promoted over the resonance line just because they exist: 4161 is a usable clean LTE cross-check, 4305 is excluded (no sensitivity). The old numbers RYA-430 was blocked on (370-633 mA) were Gaussian-EW blend artifacts; these are real synthesis numbers.
decision.not_keyed_to_asplund: The reported A(Sr II) ~2.72-2.77 sits ~0.09-0.11 dex BELOW Asplund 2.83 and was NOT adjusted toward it (validate-don't-tune). Sr I vs Sr II were NOT forced into agreement (RYA-422 ionization diagnostic is a check, never a tuning target).

engineB_synth_LTE.note: Turbospectrum LTE flux fit = Engine B

engineA_1dnlte.note: Engine A = Engine B + INSPECT NLTE delta (-0.004 at 4077); 4161/4305 have no Engine-A (NLTE_unavailable)

two_engine_rya525.note: Both engines recorded per the RYA-525 per-element format; Engine A (1D-NLTE) is the reported leg for the covered doublet. Full production two-engine freeze is gated under RYA-527.

systematics: The absolute scale carries a ~0.05-0.1 dex near-UV synthesis systematic: high red_chi2 (near-UV blend/continuum residuals), MARCS nearest-node (p5750/g4.5 vs solar 5772/4.438), and an approximate combined macro+instrumental Gaussian broadening (fit as a nuisance). Reported as-is; not tuned.
sr_i_leg: Sr I 6617 (32.46 mA EW) remains the neutral-ion leg and the RYA-422 ionization-balance cross-check; it is PRESERVED as an authoritative EW measurement (only Sr II is synthesis-routed/suppressed).
